title: ever ANNIKA| Embroidered Sequin Ruffle Sleeve Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
This dress features a V-neckline with intricate sequin embroidery that adds dimension without feeling heavy. The fitted bodice and softly flared skirt create a balanced silhouette that moves comfortably through long events. It’s a polished choice for mother of the bride, wedding guests, and formal evening occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
